mercimek.name: Isobho Le-Lentile
mercimek.description: Isobho le-lentile elenziwe ekhaya ngendlela yendabuko, eligcwele isosi yobhotela.

tas-kebabi.name: Isituwedi Yenyama Yengulube Yasendaweni YaseTurkey
tas-kebabi.description: Inyama yengulube, imifino yesizini, kanye nesosi ekhethekile ephekiwe kancane yendawo yethu yokudlela.

kuzu-tandir.name: Ingulube Ethosiwe Kancane
kuzu-tandir.description: Ingulube yethu ephuma endaweni yokudlela, ethandwayo, ephekiwe kancane phezu komlilo ophansi.

firin-sutlac.name: Ipudding Yerayisi Elibhakiwe
firin-sutlac.description: Ipudding yerayisi elibhakiwe ngendlela yendabuko, elenziwe nobisi lwamabhavu lwansuku zonke.

kuru-fasulye.name: Ishosha Elimhlophe Nenyama Yenkukhu
kuru-fasulye.description: Amabhontshisi e-İspir, inyama yenkukhu ethe xaxa, kanye nophinifa oluyinhloko lwetamatisi lwase-restshurenti.

izgara-kofte.name: Amabhola Enyama Aqhotshelwe
izgara-kofte.description: Amabhola enyama yenkomo endlela yesoka enomele obhakiwe kanye netamatisi.

ayran.name: Ayrani Eqhume
ayran.description: Ubisi olushintshiwe lwendabuko olunamafutha amaningi, lwenziwe nophizi lwansuku zonke.

ezogelin-corbasi.name: Isobho se-Ezogelin
ezogelin-corbasi.description: Isobho lesiko lesi-restshurenti lapho longobadala, bulgur, irayisi kuhlangana namint.

tarhana-corbasi.name: Isobho se-Tarhana
tarhana-corbasi.description: Tarhana yasendlini, i-Anatolian yendabuko ephekwa kancane netamatisi nemint eyomile.

yayla-corbasi.name: Ubisi Olulsayo Ne-Soup Yerayisi
yayla-corbasi.description: Isobho esisha nesinoshukela esilungiselelwe ngobisi oluphakathi, irayisi, kanye neminti eyomile.

iskembe-corbasi.name: Isobho Lezinsimbi Zenyama Yenkukhu
iskembe-corbasi.description: Isobho le-tripe lenyama yenkunzi elifanele elifakwe ezinongo zalo nasevini likagalikhi.

dugun-corbasi.name: Isobho Lomshado
dugun-corbasi.description: Isobho lomshado wendabuko elenziwe ngenkomo egayiwe futhi linambitheka ngomumo welamuni.

tavuk-suyu-corbasi.name: Isobho Lenhlamvu Yenkukhu
tavuk-suyu-corbasi.description: Isobho sokwelapha esilungiselelwe ngama-noodle amancane abiliswe ebhrothini lezinhlama futhi lenyama yenkukhu egayiwe.

domates-corbasi.name: Isobho Letamatisi
domates-corbasi.description: Ukunambitheka ocebile okuphekwe namatamatisi avuthiwe, ibhotela, ne-basil, kuphelele ngekhosi.

sebze-corbasi.name: Isobho Lezithelo Nemifino
sebze-corbasi.description: Isobho esilula esiphekiwe esitolo esenziwe ngemifino yesizini, uwoyela wemnquma, nezihlahla ezinempilo.

beyran-corbasi.name: Isobho Lombila Omnandi WeLamb Beyran
beyran-corbasi.description: Isobho lesifunda eliphekiwe kubushushu obuphezulu ne-lamb, irayisi, ugalikhi, kanye nophepha olukhuzi.

kelle-paca-corbasi.name: Isobho Kwebunzi Nezinyawo
kelle-paca-corbasi.description: Isobho somathambo ocebile esenziwe ngezinyawo zenkomo neminqulu yekhanda ebilisiwe amahora amaningi.

sehriye-corbasi.name: Isobho Le-Vermicelli
sehriye-corbasi.description: Isobho lasemini elilungiselelwe ngeshokoledi lenkukhu, amathomethi, ama-vermicelli, kanye ne-parsley.

tavuk-sis.name: Izinqe Zenhlanzi
tavuk-sis.description: Izingcezu zenkukhu ezixutshwe izinongo ezikhethekile, zikhonza nezpepo ezibhakiwe namathomethi.

kasap-sucuk.name: Inyama Yomgqomo Emasheshini
kasap-sucuk.description: Isosaji yenkomo enemnandi ephekiwe phezu komlilo, nezitshalo ezibhakiwe no-anyanisi oneshumasi.

karisik-izgara.name: Ugoqo Oluxubile
karisik-izgara.description: Ipulazi eligcwele nelihlanganisayo lokugoqa eliqukethe amabhola enyama, izinqe zenkukhu, iziphetho zengulube, kanye nesosaji.

nohut-yemegi.name: Isuphu yeChickpea Nenyama Yenkukhu
nohut-yemegi.description: Isidlo sendabuko senhlamvu zemoba nenyama yenkukhu eqoshiwe iphekiwe kancane epanini lephepha lethu lokupheka.

patlican-musakka.name: Eggplant Moussaka
patlican-musakka.description: Ibhatata elibilisiwe, inyama yasemhlabathini, kanye ne-moussaka ephekwe endlini yokubhaka nge-sosi yetamatisi, isitayela sokudlela.

zeytinyagli-taze-fasulye.name: Amabhontshisi Aluhlaza Nge-Olive Oil
zeytinyagli-taze-fasulye.description: Isitsha sendabuko ephekwe nge-olive oil namabhontshisi aluhlaza, utamatisi, no-anyanisi, kuhlanjululwe kubanda.

tavuk-sote.name: Inkukhu Eshilishwe Ngepan
tavuk-sote.description: Izingcezu zenkukhu zishilishwa phezu kokushisa okuphezulu namapepha anombala, imingu, notamatisi.

izmir-kofte.name: Ibhekeni Lezinyama Lesitayela Sase-İzmir
izmir-kofte.description: Isidlo esiyinhloko sendabuko senyama yenkomo, amazambane, nopelepele abilisiwe esitsheni esine-tamatisi.

etli-bezelye.name: Upea Nenyama
etli-bezelye.description: Isidlo sasemini esiphekwe epanini esine-cubed beef, uphizi, iklabishi elibomvu, namazambane.

patlican-oturtma.name: Ubungalowe Obilisiwe Nenyama Egayiwe
patlican-oturtma.description: Ulimi lulungiswa esithandweni ngokuhlanganiswa nobungalowe, inyama egayiwe enoshukela, nososo wetamatisi kanye nogalikhi.

salgam-suyu.name: Ijusi le-Turnip Elivuthiwe
salgam-suyu.description: Ijusi le-turnip lezinongo lendabuko elivuthiwe nekaroti emnyama notshwala be-bulgur.

maden-suyu.name: Amanzi Emineral
maden-suyu.description: Amanzi eminera omlilo wemvelo aphuzwayo abandayo.

su.name: Amanzi AseSpring Wemvelo
su.description: Amanzi asemathunjini wemvelo aphakelwa ebusika ebhodleleni lengilazi.

gazoz.name: Isoda YeLemon yaseTurkey
gazoz.description: Isoda yesintu enephephile, epholile, futhi engenamanyolo ifakwe ebandayo.

turk-kahvesi.name: Ikhofi yaseTurkey
turk-kahvesi.description: Ikhofi yesintu yaseTurkey ene-foam, iphekwe ngokushisa okuphezulu ku-cezve yensimbi yensimbi.

demleme-cay.name: Itiye Eliphekiwe LaseTurkey
demleme-cay.description: Itiye elisha le-Rize elicwecwe ngaphezulu ebhodlelini elincanyana.

ev-yapimi-limonata.name: I-Lemonade Eyenziwe Ekhaya
ev-yapimi-limonata.description: I-lemonade epholile elungiselelwa nsuku zonke ngomlomo, minti, noshukela omncane.

hosaf.name: I-Fruit Compote Yansuku zonke
hosaf.description: I-compote yasekhaya ebiliswa nsuku zonke ngamarhe, ama-apricot, noma amapulomu ngokwesizini.

iskender-kebabi.name: Bursa İskender Kebab
iskender-kebabi.description: Inyama ijikiswa esikhwameni phezu kwe-pide, ikhishwa no-tomato sauce, ibhotela eshisayo, kanye no-yogathi.

kazandibi.name: I-Pudding yobisi olubhalwe i-Caramel
kazandibi.description: Isidlo sodaka lobisi esidala esishiswe kahle, sinobunono obuthambile.

tavuk-gogsu.name: I-Pudding yobisi lwama-Ottoman
tavuk-gogsu.description: Isidlo esilula futhi esinamafayibha esenziwe ngobisi esilungiswe ngeresiphi yendabuko, sikhonza ne-s Cinnamon.

keskul.name: Ipudding Yobisi Lwe-almond
keskul.description: Isidlo sobisi sesitayela sase-Ottoman esigcotshwe ukunambitheka kwe-almond kanye nekhokho.

irmik-helvasi.name: I-Semolina Halva
irmik-helvasi.description: IHalva ye-semolina, ephonswa nobhotela nezinhlamvu zomapine, ikhonzwa ishisa futhi inommbila.

kabak-tatlisi.name: Isidlo Sekhowe Ngetahini
kabak-tatlisi.description: Ikhowe, iphekwe kancane ekhilimu layo, ikhonzwa ngetahini kanye namawolintshi.

ayva-tatlisi.name: Isidlo Seqince
ayva-tatlisi.description: I-Qince ephekwe ne-clove ne-cinnamon ikhonzwa nekhrimu eligoqiwe kanye namawolintshi.

revani.name: Ikhekhe Le-Semolina Eline-Syrup
revani.description: Isidlo esidumile sase-restaurenti lapho ikhekhe elithambile le-semolina lihlangabezana ne-syrup enuka ulamula.

ekmek-kadayifi.name: Pudding Yesinkwa Eline-Cream Egxitshwe
ekmek-kadayifi.description: Pudding yesinkwa ephumule ne-syrup epholiswe ikakhulukazi idliwe ne-buffalo cream egxitshwe.

cevizli-baklava.name: Walnut Baklava
cevizli-baklava.description: Izendlalelo ezigoqwayo zibe thin, i-baklava eqinile yenziwe nge-walnut eningi kanye nobhotela olujwayelekile.
